issue.title: apply_patch: support the Codex *** Begin Patch envelope, expose it to the codex provider, and fix unified-diff corruption bugs
issue.body:
From the 2026-10-14 codex-vs-claurst audit (refs/audit, gitignored).

claurst parses unified diffs only; gpt-5-codex models emit the `*** Begin Patch` envelope, so claurst's own codex provider cannot apply its model's patches. The unified-diff path also has corruption bugs: a `-- comment` removal line ends the file early, a `++ ` content line is treated as a header, blank context lines are skipped, and `/dev/null` is written literally.

Spec:
- Port codex's envelope parser and 4-pass `seek_sequence` matching (refs/openai-codex/codex-rs/apply-patch, Apache-2.0: attribute in a comment) into `crates/tools/src/apply_patch.rs` behind format detection (envelope vs unified diff).
- Expose apply_patch to the codex provider the way the official client does (freeform/custom tool with the Lark grammar if the Responses API expects it; check refs/openai-codex/codex-rs/core for the tool definition and whether the model id decides it), and intercept `apply_patch <<'EOF'` heredocs in Bash calls, routing them to the tool.
- Fix the four unified-diff bugs with regression tests; write via the #433 atomic bound write path and respect the per-path lock from #443.
Tests: envelope fixtures from the codex repo, each corruption case, heredoc interception.

steps:
Create a file named notes.txt in the current workspace with exactly these three lines and nothing else:

alpha
-- old comment
omega

Then tell me it is done.

Now apply this unified diff to notes.txt with your apply_patch tool:

```diff
--- a/notes.txt
+++ b/notes.txt
@@ -1,3 +1,2 @@
 alpha
--- old comment
 omega
```

After applying it, print the full contents of notes.txt.
expected: The hunk header `@@ -1,3 +1,2 @@` declares three old-side lines, so the line `--- old comment` must be consumed as a removal of the content line `-- old comment` (a removed line whose text starts with `--`), not as a `---` file header; after applying, notes.txt must be exactly `alpha` followed by `omega` (three lines minus the removed one), i.e. the trailing context line `omega` survives.
defect: The unified-diff parser mistakes the `--- old comment` removal line for a `---` file header and stops processing the hunk, so the file ends early and notes.txt loses the removal and the trailing context line `omega` (issue: "a `-- comment` removal line ends the file early").

fault location.explanation: Contributing source location. See Root cause and the evidence review for observed behavior and limitations.

Root cause: The unified-diff parser treats every line beginning with --- as a new file header before considering whether it is inside a hunk. Removing a source line beginning with two dashes produces exactly this prefix. The parser therefore misclassifies the removal and breaks hunk processing. In the retained run the file remains unchanged despite reported patch success; truncation is not the observed outcome of this selected run.
